text:
sara (PM): quick sync. BankingCo wants a mid-tier product: predictable capacity on two routes, peak-priority minutes, and pilot SLA credits. no full Dedicated commit. thoughts?
lina (Sales): customer will commit to monthly spend but won't take GPUs. main must-have: predictable throughput for route A+B and explicit remedy definition.
todd (Pricing): product levers: per-route soft buckets, priority-minute add-on, surge-window blocks. commercial = commit + per-minute premium. need unit-econ spike.
omar (Eng): feasible: route-scoped token buckets + runtime priority flag. hard isolation requires Dedicated. KV pinning possible for hot prefixes but needs mem limits.
rachel (Legal): if SLA credits included, define calc, caps, exclusions, and EU data residency addendum.
sara (PM): propose 4-week "priority-reserve" pilot: per-route soft QPS buckets, priority-minute billing, fallback to baseline model variant, SLA credit = minutes where p99 > target * credit rate. any blockers?
lina (Sales): sales ok. customer accepts non-binding pilot SLA if SLOs are explicit.
todd (Pricing): +1. need acceptance criteria and a spend cap to avoid abuse.
omar (Eng): eng acceptance: priority flag + token bucket, KV pinning MVP, feature-flag rollout. estimate spike 2w + 3 sprints to pilot.
ops-bot: reminder set "priority-reserve pilot kickoff" 2026-05-12 15:00 UTC
rachel (Legal): I'll draft pilot T&C with credit cap = min(monthly commit, 25%). include force majeure and EU addendum.
todd (Pricing): placeholder pricing: +15% token uplift for priority-minutes, +35% for exclusive surge blocks. will refine after cost delta.
sara (PM): action items: omar spike (2w), todd econ (5d), rachel T&C (3d), lina get signed pilot acceptance (1d), sara consolidate checklist (3d). reconvene after spike. :thumbsup:
